headline: Gold fluctuates as traders assess Federal Reserve rate path and Mideast risks
summary: Gold prices fluctuated as traders assessed the outlook for the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path alongside potential renewed hostilities in the Middle East.
why: Precious metals often trade as safe-haven assets during geopolitical uncertainty and are heavily influenced by real interest rates driven by central bank policies.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Conflicting signals between Federal Reserve interest rate expectations and geopolitical safe-haven demand caused choppy trading.

why_moved: Market participants continuously re-evaluate the safe-haven value of gold against changing expectations for U.S. monetary policy and geopolitical tensions.
